cases.sentence: – Да, – подтвердил он, – и княгиня Тверская совершенно неуместно вмешивается в самые трудные ___.
cases.explain: «семейные дела» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “Yes,” he assented; “and Princess Tverskaya’s interference in the most difficult private affairs is utterly uncalled for. She especially. …”

cases.sentence: Она тревожно играла кистями халата, взглядывая на него с тем ___ физического отвращения к нему, за которое она упрекала себя, но которого не могла преодолеть.
cases.explain: «мучительным чувством» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Alexey Alexandrovitch sighed and said nothing. She played nervously with the tassel of her dressing-gown, glancing at him with that torturing sensation of physical repulsion for which she blamed herself, though she could not control it. Her only desire now was to be rid of his oppressive presence.
